title: User-Tooling Layer: Graduating Conversational Mechanisms to Artifact-Producing Form
summary: Conversational mechanisms that cannot be step-anchored or hook-verified are made governable by requiring them to produce an artifact at a canonical path (the gate reflection note is the first instance); the manifest check enforces existence and shape, not epistemic substance (the reframe-derailed gate limitation).

supersession.text: The gate reflection note's required structure gains one section: "Susceptibility snapshot findings and orchestrator triage" (or "Findings and orchestrator triage" at non-gate practitioner-facing moments). The reframe-derailed gate limitation remains current and applies to the triage record as well.

links.note: the gate reflection note gains the required section "Susceptibility snapshot findings and orchestrator triage" (finding, disposition, what was done)
